summary: Hydro One Limited filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing that its subsidiary Hydro One Networks Inc. has filed a leave-to-construct application with the Ontario Energy Board to build the Durham Kawartha Power Line, a ~55-km transmission line. The ~$430 million investment is expected to be in service by 2029. First Nations may invest in a 50% equity stake. This is a regulatory application for infrastructure construction, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven corporate action is involved.
